questions.question_en: What is wrong with interpreting perennial as identical discharge throughout the year?
questions.question_te: Perennial అంటే year-round identical Q అనడం ఎందుకు తప్పు?
options: All rivers receive exactly the same inputs
Flow regulation eliminates every seasonal difference
Continuous flow can still have strong seasonal variation
Perennial means the river flows only once
option_explanations: Catchment inputs vary.
Regulated rivers can also vary.
Perennial concerns persistence, not constancy of rate.
That describes neither perennial flow nor a normal regime.
